diagnosis.boundary: Web Audio output readiness before the initial native playback launch
diagnosis.cause: AudioWorklet process acknowledgement at process time zero preceded progress at the output-device stream position. Starting native PCM production on that acknowledgement filled the 16,384-frame queue before output began.
diagnosis.fix: After the matching Worklet acknowledgement, keep native launch pending until AudioContext.getOutputTimestamp().contextTime is strictly greater than the acknowledged process_time. The existing five-second readiness deadline covers both waits; invalid or unavailable timestamps fail explicitly.
diagnosis.api_semantics: The W3C Web Audio specification defines AudioTimestamp.contextTime as the context time of the sample frame currently rendered by the output device: https://www.w3.org/TR/webaudio-1.0/#dom-audiocontext-getoutputtimestamp
